title: nodes block, schema 2: the node tree, the only geography
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §3 (K-R10..K-R29). An ordered array: declaration order is the last tie-break of locate. Every place, region, building, room or level is a node; the tree is built from parent links. Tree rules the schema cannot express (unique ids, parent exists, no cycle, enter is a child, an explicit alias list contains the name) are checked by tools/check_pack.py and map/core/pack-v2.mjs; at run time they heal item by item (K-R06, K-R12).

at.description: Position in the frame of view (when given: the primary view of an ancestor), else of the nearest ancestor view that has a frame (K-R31): 0..1 of width / height for tiles and image, model units for model3d. r = radius of the spot in the same units. Editors always write view.

link.description: A passage to another node shown on the place card (stairs, lift, road). Not a parent relation.

id.description: Unique in the pack, stable forever (chat data refers to it). Growth creates ids starting with g_; exported packs keep them (K-R10).

name.description: Display name, verbatim from the card for card-backed nodes.

type.description: Author-named kind (world, city, layer, room, …). Open vocabulary; the kernel never branches on it. Default: none.

parent.description: Absent = hangs under the pack root (K-R12).

alias.description: Strong names: any text containing one of them (whole words in spaced scripts) points at this node. An explicit list must contain name unless name is listed in hints. Default when absent: name plus the i18n names, without a leading article (K-R15).

hints.description: Weak words: place at this node at most, never deeper; lose to aliases outside this subtree (K-R16). Hints on the root mark ambiguous words: they hide shorter words inside them and never decide a result. A word in both lists of the same node counts as a hint.

desc.description: Longer description for the place card.

anchor.description: Position by reference: a region id in the nearest ancestor view's region table (points file, 3D hotspot, plan polygon). Default: the node id. Ignored when at is given (K-R32).

view.description: View id(s) in the views block; first = primary. Default: views[<node id>] when it exists (K-R33).

enter.description: Child whose view opens when this node is the target and has no view that opens on locate. Default: none, the nearest framed ancestor view is shown focused on this node (K-R34).

media.description: The node's pictures, in order: ids of the media block (K-R101). An id the block does not have is dropped.
